overview: Southern France, 1504. Nero is a cynical and surly assassin who is betrayed by his master and long-term ally. Running from the dangerous enemies now after him, he discovers his own orphaned daughter Perla. On their journey between vengeance and redemption, Nero will have to choose: saving himself or saving his daughter — and the world.
title: Néro
La Haine : La scène est à nous

overview: 25 years after a tragedy that affected her and her friends, Bérénice is a restorative justice mediator. But is it possible to believe in rehabilitation? Especially now, with the culprit back in their lives.
title: Mea Culpa

overview: Quebec's 1997 biker war peaked with two prison guard murders. After an informant named Boucher as mastermind, investigators and prosecutors worked to convict him in a landmark case.
title: L'Appel

overview: Jay & Pamela following a couple who also happen to share the same rare brittle bone disorder. Their lives are full of unique and difficult physical challenges, but their enduring enthusiasm is contagious. With plans to marry and a goal to live more independently, Jay and Pamela navigate the world in their motorized wheelchairs, determined to build the life of their dreams together.
title: Jay & Pamela

overview: Gangster Franck Pistone, who's been on the run for 17 years after having pulling off the heist of the century, returns to Brussels to reconcile with his children because he feels his end is near.
title: Fils De

overview: When her client dies on the eve of his wedding, a florist sets out to find the killer, unearthing high society's dark secrets — while keeping her own.
title: Dala Bupha Khattakam

overview: Lugar 54 is a five-episode fiction series that takes place in a parking lot, exploring the characters that live a single parking spot throughout each episode. Each episode approaches a different genre, from drama, to comedy, to fantasy and crime.
title: Lugar 54

overview: House of Knives, where talented, innovative and ruthless contenders must use their cooking, strategy and survival skills to make it to the throne. The competition names a weekly ruler based on challenges that reflect the contenders' personal stories, food influences and cultures, while the least successful chefs are banished. There are always six players in the game, so eliminations are followed with a dramatic reveal: a brand-new legendary chef entering the arena.
title: House of Knives

overview: Princess Xiao Ningyun of Tianyun Kingdom becomes a blood slave after her nation fell. She is bought by Prince Duan of Daliang, Chen Fengxue, who torments her due to past grudges. Yet, as he uses her for his own purposes, he finds himself drawn to her without him knowing. After enduring numerous trials, they resolve their misunderstandings and confess their true feelings to one another. In the end, they choose to retreat into seclusion together in the mountains.
title: The Prisoner of Love

overview: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So his mission continues.
title: Takedown with Chris Hansen

overview: As a child, Eşref fell in love from afar with a girl he called "Rüya" and spent years searching for her, only to become a powerful mafia figure along the way. Meanwhile, Nisan, an idealistic musician, finds herself in grave danger after performing at a wedding held at Eşref's hotel. Eşref falls for Nisan, unaware that she is both the long-lost Rüya he has been chasing for years and a police informant. Trapped in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles, Eşref is forced into a brutal reckoning — both with his criminal empire and his own emotions.
title: Eşref Rüya

overview: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.
title: KPOPPED

overview: Ed Bex is a man with an eating disorder: as soon as he puts something in his mouth, he sees what happened to it. He uses this special gift in his unusual job: with 'The Last Greeting' he helps relatives to reconstruct the last hours of their dearly deceased. When Inspector Adams finds a body in an airtight bag, he asks for Ed's help. Ed has doubts: does he want to use his gift in a murder case? When he does get stuck into the case, he becomes entangled in a mix of absurd situations, personal chaos and deep pangs of conscience.
title: Dood Spoor

overview: Rishabh and Surbhi's arranged marriage hits turbulence as past secrets resurface. Amid light moments, they navigate an unfolding bond, torn between desires and cultural norms.
title: Bada Naam Karenge

overview: Between 1861 and 1865, Americans made war on each other and killed each other in great numbers - if only to become the kind of country that could no longer conceive of how that was possible. What began as a bitter dispute over Union and States' Rights, ended as a struggle over the meaning of freedom in America.
title: The Civil War

overview: On his way home, Michael, a professor specializing in the history of terrorism, saves the life of a seriously injured boy. He then meets the parents, Oliver and Cheryl, who live in his neighborhood. They sympathize. But Michael is intrigued by a plan he sees at Oliver's house. When he finds out that the latter was not educated in Kansas as he claims, Michael persuades himself that Oliver is hiding something and decides to investigate. He then realizes that his neighbor had assumed the identity of a dead man years ago.
title: Arlington Road

overview: Hollywood Arts follows Trina Vega returning to her old stomping grounds as the newest teacher at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.
title: Hollywood Arts

overview: Joe Rogan hosts long form conversations with friends and guests that include comedians, actors, musicians, MMA instructors and commentators, authors and artists.
title: The Joe Rogan Experience

overview: Prisoner — a high-stakes action thriller following a principled young prison officer escorting a dangerous, high-value prisoner to court to testify against his elite crime syndicate.
title: Prisoner

overview: Instant Italian works to take favorite Italian dishes and make them quick and easy for modern home cooks. Drawing on inspiration from her childhood visiting family in Calabria, Anna is known for her ingenious spins on familiar dishes. Whether she is transforming pasta with a snackable fried version (just minutes in an air fryer), perfecting a deeply flavored chicken cacciatore for an easy sheet-pan supper, or putting a creative twist on desserts like affogato mug cake and cannoli icebox cake, Anna is always finding fun and unique ways to update meals while still keeping the flavors true to their roots.
title: Instant Italian

overview: Schmeichel is not just a story of a sport icon and his success; it's also a touching family story of triumphs, setbacks, and personal redemption. The two-part documentary delves into Schmeichel's astonishing 22-year football career and life beyond the sport. Featuring unprecedented access to the international sporting hero, with a mix of never-before-seen personal archive footage, interviews with Peter Schmeichel, his family and key figures such as Sir Alex Ferguson, Eric Cantona and Gary Neville who have been a part of his journey both on and off the pitch. Schmeichel played a key role in the Danish national team's sensational victory at the 1992 UEFA European Championship and was an indispensable part of Manchester United's most successful era under Sir Alex Ferguson.
title: Schmeichel

overview: GibsonTV The Collection: Join host Mark Agnesi to get a close-up look at the guitar collections of some of the world's most iconic guitarists and singer-songwriters. In this exclusive series, your favorite musical icons share stories about their most prized and most recognizable guitars.
title: GibsonTV The Collection
Naati Pinky Ki Lambi Love Story

overview: Nadya Chudova, a graduate of the Moscow Medical Academy, decides to work in a provincial hospital in her hometown after graduating, where she was once saved by a talented surgeon, Andrei Krylov. Nadya gives the impression of being an eccentric, but in fact has a unique gift for seeing illness with the help of synesthesia, a neurological phenomenon that appeared after an accident she experienced in her youth. Although her unusual abilities help her in her work, they cause irony and ridicule among those around her.
title: Чудо-доктор

overview: A devoted sister's attempt to help her only sibling conceive stirs buried jealousy and anger, shattering their bond and leaving pain, broken loyalty, and lost love.
title: Roses and Ivy

overview: Thirteen brave women share stories of the psychological, emotional and economic abuse they suffered under the controversial religious group Opus Dei.
title: El minuto heroico: Yo también dejé el Opus Dei

overview: Yu Chuxin and Zhou Chuming were once a sweet couple until Lin Qingqing's interference destroyed their marriage. After losing her child and nearly her life, Yu Chuxin, consumed by despair over her family's suffering, clings to her fraying sanity. She feigns selective amnesia, fixating her memory on the early days of her marriage to Zhou Chuming. Under this guise, she returns to the Zhou Family to covertly gather evidence, determined to ensure all who wronged her face justice.
title: Return of Fated Love

overview: From the creator of "Love is Blind" comes Sweethearts which follows the lives of 6 teenage couples in Charleston, SC. As they navigate the end of high school and get ready for college, each couple must decide if they will begin the next chapter of their lives together… or begin their adult lives single. Whatever they choose, one thing's for sure: it will change the course of their lives forever.
title: Sweethearts

overview: Pulling from an archive of more than 10,000 interviews recorded over nearly 50 years, David Frost Vs centres on era-defining interviews conducted by legendary broadcaster Sir David Frost. Seen through Frost's eyes, we encounter the flashpoints of the mid-to-late 20th century that made it a furnace of change and uncertainty, tumultuous times that continue to permeate our world today. Across the series, Frost's career acts as a roughly chronological spine, as we journey through recent history via his astonishing rise, with commentary and insights from the Frost family and famous faces who knew him best. Each episode is anchored around Frost's interviews with one key personality, providing a jumping board into deeply resonant themes; from explosive encounters with Muhammad Ali on African American civil rights, to the deeply divisive student protest movement against the Vietnam War framed through Frost's conversations with Jane Fonda, and exploring the dark side of fame via revealing interviews with Sir Elton John.
title: David Frost vs...

overview: The beloved casts from the hit reality series — EXchange: Seasons 1, 2, and 3 — reunite for an exciting new chapter! This spin-off focuses on new dynamics, unexpected connections, and captivating chemistry as past participants embark on thrilling journeys together. Centered around travel and friendships, the show promises heartfelt moments and unforgettable experiences.
title: EXchange: Another Beginning

overview: Mutant Weather explores how weather patterns are changing and threatening life on our planet. The series explains why weather-related phenomena have dramatically transformed in the last few decades. Today's weather events are growing in size, speed and intensity, producing very unusual and often catastrophic anomalies.
title: Mutant Weather

overview: Unconventional is a bold, hilarious, and deeply authentic look at modern queer life. This irreverent comedy follows Noah Guillory, a queer millennial juggling a decade-long marriage, the uncertainty of fatherhood, and the chaos of academia—all while acting as a sperm donor for his sister's wife.
title: Unconventional

overview: A deep dive into the sinister world of romance scams, financial frauds, and digital cons, showing how perpetrators manipulate trust and prey on human vulnerabilities. Through compelling interviews with victims, their families, and law enforcement, the series explores how seemingly harmless interactions can spiral into life-altering tragedies
title: A Perfect Scam

overview: Everyone's favorite Tiny House experts John Weisbarth and Zack Giffin take a trip down memory lane where they'll count down their top 10 builds in each episode of this exciting new series.
title: Tiny House Nation: Memory Lane

overview: In Real Madrid, the requirement to win all the titles puts its executives, coaching staff and players to the test every year. In the 2023-24 season, the club strengthens to build a roster that can rise to the challenge: completing a decade that can turn the team into a legend and writing a new golden chapter for the team in football's history.
title: Real Madrid: Cómo no te voy a querer

overview: The action takes place in the 9th and 10th centuries during the reign of Simeon. This period is known as the" golden age " in Bulgarian history. In the time of Tsar Simeon, the independence of the Bulgarian Kingdom was established. Church books are translated into Bulgarian. Bulgarian bookishness is being created.
title: Zlatniyat vek

overview: Danny, a content creator running an independent online channel, receives an unexpected proposal from Ho Yeon, a long-time fan.
title: Only for Fans

overview: A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jungwoo experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities.
title: Checkered Shirt

overview: Despite the setback of not debuting with his original group and the emotional baggage he carries, Kang Min continues to practice relentlessly. He faces pressure to succeed, with reminders of his peers already debuting and achieving their dreams. One such day of practicing lends him a long overdue reunion with an ex-boyfriend of his - Su Ho, who used to train alongside Kang Min but is now a debuted idol, looking to practice in the dance room with his other two group members. Storming past the idols, Kang Min leaves the dance room, with Su Ho tailing behind hoping to make amends. Su Ho's attempts at reconciliation are met with anger and resentment, "Who can forget being betrayed by the person they trusted the most? How could that memory go away?"
title: TwosomeBoys

overview: Couple influencers, Eun Seong and Ji Yeon, have only dated for 3 months, but thanks to the algorithm, their popularity skyrocketed. Now broken up, they've been pretending to be a couple for 6 months! Just when everything seemed stable, Gang U enters the picture, leaving Eun Seong torn between his influencer life and true love.
title: Influencer lover

overview: Having lived his entire life as a piano prodigy, Dong Uk finds himself envying Seong Hun's superior talent - but at the same time, he falls in love with him.
title: Accent

overview: A sweet romance between the president and the staff.
title: All for you

overview: Cui Xi Yue, the descendant of the princess exiled in a foreign country, changed her name to Hua Yue Er and sneaked into E country to avenge her enemy Ke Yi. She approached Ke Yi's beloved Wei Li and unexpectedly found that he was her childhood friend. During her revenge, she discovered that the real culprit was Ke Yi's brother Ke Yun, who had been eyeing her for a long time, and she fell into the "sweet trap" designed by him.
title: Royal Highness Princess

overview: The life of a three-generation mother-daughter in Daechi-dong, where Jung Eun, an avid working mother, prepares for her daughter's '7th birthday' and entrusts Ji Ah to drive her to school.
title: Mother and Mom

overview: Gu Qingcheng, a young florist from the "Flower Capital" of Pingcheng, is guided by a mysterious firefly and accidentally inhales the "flower spirit" of a white peony while trying to save it. Little does she know, this white peony is actually Lyu Gengyun, a thousand-year-old half-demon. Since childhood, Gu Qingcheng has been determined to revive 9,999 flowers, following her father's dying wish, believing that once she succeeds, the Flower Immortal Lord will take her to the heavens to meet the person she longs for. That fateful night, Lyu Gengyun awakens within a giant white peony, and the sight convinces Gu Qingcheng that he is the Flower Immortal Lord. She immediately pledges herself as his disciple. Lyu Gengyun, seeking a way to extract the flower spirit from within her and uncover the truth behind his parents' wrongful fate, has no choice but to stay by her side under a false identity, waiting for the right opportunity. But to his shock, Gu Qingcheng turns out to be the infamous "Flower Thief" feared by many… As the two embark on a series of magical adventures, their hearts gradually draw closer. Yet, with the cycle of fate looming over them and the real Flower Immortal Lord making his appearance, they are once again faced with a new wave of choices and challenges.
title: Love of Petals

overview: The series follows the thrilling adventures of Michael Knight, a detective thought to be dead, who's been given a new face and identity. His assignment: to fight crime with the help of an artificially intelligent, talking car named K.I.T.T., a high-speed, futuristic weapon outfitted with high-tech gadgets and a personality of its own. Driven by justice, they set out to take down criminals who operate above the law.
title: Knight Rider

overview: Carina Berg and Carolina Gynning dive deep into everything to do with sex, love and relationships. They visit everything from exciting experts to colourful people with eye-opening specialist knowledge.
title: Bättre sex

overview: An investigation into the greatest man-made structures of all time, exploring how new materials and construction techniques have allowed engineers, builders and architects to work to the limits of their ability. The series focuses on the buildings that re-wrote the rulebook, and the architects, engineers and builders who made the impossible possible.
title: How Did They Build That?

overview: He claims he was an agent for the CIA while producing TV series with young people. Bjørn Hallstrøm tells his incredible story.
title: Agenten – pappas liv og løgner

overview: From Glacier Point to El Capitan, Yosemite Falls, to spectacular visuals of iconic geology, flora, and fauna of present-day Yosemite, come along with Kevin Costner for the ride.
title: Yellowstone to Yosemite with Kevin Costner

overview: A documentary series hosted by John Rhys-Davies based on articles published in the magazine "Archaeology."
title: Archaeology

overview: Documentary detailing daily life inside Beaumont's Neurosurgery Department.
title: Brain Doctors: Inside Neurosurgery

overview: An Binh is very self-conscious about his appearance because of burn scars from his childhood, so that he doesn't have the courage to pursue his dream of a music career and always hides behind a mask when singing. Minh Thang in contrast is a strong, open-minded guy who dares to say and do what he wants. Because of an incident, the two of them meet and so a love story begins that is both interesting, humorous, and equally touching about the journey of overcoming the limits in pursuing what they love.
title: Fight For Love

overview: A biopic about the life of singer Lyudmila Zykina.
title: Людмила

overview: The extraordinary lengths insurance fraudsters go to, in order to receive bumper pay outs.
title: Rogue Claimers

overview: Can batch cooking truly transform our dinnertimes? In this brand-new series, Joe Swash and batch cooking expert Suzanne Mulholland, aka The Batch Lady, dish out a proper helping of inspiration as they help families with great time-saving tips and easy-to-follow recipes, and prove that anyone can make mealtimes stress-free, transforming family life.
title: Batch from Scratch: Cooking for Less

overview: Two best mates, two bikes and over 200 miles of beautiful French landscape. David Baddiel and Hugh Dennis, who've been friends for 40 years, pedal through France while getting up to mischief, exploring stunning local sights and having a good chat along the way.
title: Two Men On A Bike

overview: The Neighbourhood will see real-life households from all walks of life move in side by side, finding themselves not only neighbours but also fierce competitors in the ultimate reality showdown. This is a game the households will live as well as play. They'll be with each other 24/7, sleeping and eating in their houses, socialising between them - and then voting each other out. The challenges they face in public will change the dynamics behind closed doors. And to win, they'll need to defeat their neighbours, while still staying popular on the street. In The Neighbourhood, it's not about keeping up with the Joneses - it's about beating them!
title: The Neighbourhood

overview: The Tent Mender, a recovering heroin addict, returns to Skid Row after being sober for 15 years. While embarking on his journey of self-discovery, he meets and connects with some of the 14,000 people living on the streets.
title: The Tent Mender

overview: Follow top bikini models as they set sail on a array of adventures to the world's most alluring locations. Every half hour episode will showcase glamorous swimsuit models on photo shoots around the world. From the beautiful white sand beaches of the Bahamas to the exotic islands of Tahiti... Bikini Destinations is an invitation to enchantment.
title: Bikini Destinations

overview: The stubborn young man Shen Jingyu is disturbed by a mysterious Chinese Valentine's Day divination magic. He could not accept that his destiny was to live temporarily in his house with his neighbor Gu Senhe who often asked him "Are you happy today?" Shen Jingyu, who had been tortured to death, spent his whole life trying to get the god of plague out of his house as soon as possible, but with little success. But for some reason, inappropriate pink bubbles always float in the air. In this way, the two teenagers spent a ridiculous and unforgettable vacation.
title: Pink Summer

overview: Seul Gi gets a job at a chocolate shop and, no matter how hard she tries, she can't seem to adapt to the environment. Despite trying to overcome her alienation with positivity, she always ends up getting hurt. One day, at Honggeumdang, a place she visited to fix a broken watch, Seul Gi falls in love with the charm of whiskey and artisanal chocolate. With this in mind, she becomes the only member of a task force that will participate in an internal Valentine's Day contest. She starts collaborating with the owner of Honggeumdang to create the best chocolate ever, but ends up having trouble finding teammates. That's when Hyun Nam, a chocolate freak, and Jeremy, an outgoing influencer, show up. Now, this trio and Mr. Hong, who is nice in a weird way, will have the chance to create the best Valentine's Day chocolate.
title: Our Chocolate Moments

overview: In the downturn of the filming industry, Yiping Film Company launched an innovative reality show "Live Cave Exploration". Famous actor Li Kaixuan and a few ordinary people attended the show, but a series of strange and horrible things happened. They were also caught in a trap set by a mysterious person. After they experienced the test of humanity, the terrible truth was slowly revealed.
title: Abyss Live

overview: Compayito's artistic career is in shambles—until he meets Zacarías. He and his fun-loving family adopt Compayito and help him become famous again.
title: ¡Chócalas Compayito!

overview: Luke Macfarlane takes audiences inside a house that has been inherited or holds special familial meaning, and is overdue for a facelift. Alongside Designer Olivia Westbrooks, they update the home with a nod to the past.
title: Home is Where the Heart Is

overview: Cold Blooded Liar is set in postcard-perfect San Diego, where strong-willed homicide detective Kit McKittrick uses her ferocious determination and heightened empathy from her foster kid background to solve the most chilling murder cases the city has ever seen. As she confronts some of the darkest corners of humanity, she meets a handsome, insightful psychologist named Sam Reeves, and together, their partnership develops into a transformative bond.
title: Cold Blooded Liar

overview: Funboys sees friends Callum, Jordan and Lorcan as they attempt to navigate through the hardships of life. Life is never easy for this trio of sad worms: from first girlfriends to dead pet pigs, the lads are put through the psychological ringer. But will their shared love of innocent fun and wholesome mucking about land them in hot water?
title: Funboys

overview: A young woman from southern Baden goes jogging and never comes back. After an intensive search, her body is found a few days later. Beaten to death by an unknown person. A special investigation unit is put together and begins to meticulously secure evidence - until a second murder occurs just 30 kilometers away and the team has to find out whether and how the two cases are connected. The four-part series "Spuren" is based on true events, without exploiting or dramatizing the two crimes that shook the region around Freiburg in 2016. This is not about quick sensationalism, about the bloody celebration of two terrible crimes, it is more about classic police work.
title: Spuren

overview: Se Hoon is a model student with good grades, but an unfortunate incident on the bus one day earns him the humiliating nickname of ‘Erector.' The choir director, Won Dae, asks him to be his running mate for the upcoming student council election. Needing to rehabilitate his image, Se Hoon agrees, only to find out that he is Won Dae's twelfth running mate. With his pride bruised, Se Hoon decides to join Sang Hyun, a walking luxury man known as the local social butterfly.
title: Running Mate

overview: A British chat show hosted by Dana Rosemary Scallon.
title: A Day with Dana

overview: Berlin, the final stop on a honeymoon trip around the world. Josh and Zofia from New York are looking for the ultimate kick: a night in the techno club "Reaktor"! Hard door, powerful bass - finally inside! Suddenly she disappears into the crowd: an emergency text message from the club team and a dramatic night in hospital follow. In the morning, Josh learns of his wife's death. Rosa hears about the tragedy in the waiting room. Now the journalist wants to know what happened.
title: The Next Level

overview: The history of the NBA is full of legends, perhaps a lifetime would not be enough to tell them all, but Péter Scherer will try. In the Sport TV series Mesél a Pálya, he tells us stories about 10 excellent basketball players for 10 episodes. He does it all the way only he knows how.
title: NBA - Mesél a Pálya

overview: Uncover the alleged crimes, deceit, violence and manipulations of a once-revered spiritual leader, Asaram.
title: Cult of Fear: Asaram Bapu

overview: 1987. On the air of the program "Vzglyad", in front of the whole country, journalist Vadim Belozerov has his arm pierced with a long "Gypsy" needle. At the same time, he continues to host the program as if nothing had happened. Not only TV viewers are surprised: Belozerov's colleagues know that the journalist is deathly afraid of any injections and cannot stand even the slightest pain. Belozerov explains: he was anesthetized remotely, with a look, by a guest in the studio, psychotherapist Anatoly Kashpirovsky. A few months later, in March 1988, on the air of the same "Vzglyad", Dr. Kashpirovsky will conduct a unique teleconference: he will anesthetize a woman who is on the operating table many kilometers away, in Kyiv. The experiment will be repeated in 1989, this time with two patients at once. And on October 9, 1989, the first "Kashpirovsky Session" was broadcast. Today it seems that these sessions lasted for several years, but in fact, there were only 8 episodes. This was enough for them to become iconic, and the doctor's phrases, for example, "I give the order!" - winged. Kashpirovsky himself remained one of the most famous, mysterious and controversial figures of the perestroika era. In the program, Anatoly Kashpirovsky appears in a new capacity: now he is not only a psychotherapist, capable of making you forget about pain with his gaze or giving a "order for good". He is the chief judge and expert in the field of the unknown and inexplicable, everything that goes beyond human understanding. Psychics, telepathy and telekinesis, ghosts, dream mysteries, damage and the evil eye, signs of fate - all these topics excite many, but cannot always be explained by modern science. In each episode of the program, the doctor, having chosen one of these topics, will conduct a comprehensive investigation. Mysterious stories, eyewitness accounts and witnesses of incredible events flock to the mobile headquarters of Anatoly Kashpirovsky. He studies them, evaluates their veracity and tries to separate the facts from harmless fiction or disguised fraud. It is not easy to make the doctor believe: he rejects many stories that are convincing to the uninitiated right away, while others he goes to study personally. On the instructions of Anatoly Kashpirovsky, unique experiments are carried out in real time in front of TV viewers, and he himself takes direct part in some of them.
title: Сеанс с Кашпировским

overview: The love story of Natalia Goncharova and Alexander Pushkin was short, but intense, passionate and, ultimately, sad. The plot centers on the fate of a woman who became the wife and muse of a brilliant poet, the mother of his four children, a socialite and an apple of discord. She dreamed of simple human happiness, but her love went down in history.
title: Натали и Александр
